exact.sh: False when this is a closest-match guess

guide.sh: The 10ML guide comparing this perfume with its alternatives

id.sh: Stable Fragrance Index id, usable with get_perfume and find_similar_perfumes

key_notes.sh: The defining notes (empty when no pyramid is published)

message.sh: Guidance when the result is empty, partial or needs a follow-up tool

next_cursor.sh: Pass as cursor to get the next page; absent on the last page

other_matches.sh: Other originals the query could also mean

other_versions.sh: Ids of other concentrations or flankers of the same perfume in the index

total.sh: How many results matched in all

translated.sh: False when the guide is only available in English (the url is then the English page)

info.description: Free perfume API and fragrance notes API from the 10ML Fragrance Index: 6,000+ perfumes and 249 houses with note pyramids, accords, families, similar scents, alternatives from other houses, notes explained and guides, curated by 10ML's fragrance editors. The same answers as the 10ML Perfume Finder MCP server at https://mcp.10ml.com/mcp. No API key, no sign-up, read-only JSON over GET.
